notes: Two university-layer documents (UTDSP5017 and the OIT Atlas explainer). Main disagreements: (1) unit_stance on delegation, verification and benefit lines (permit/prohibit vs neutral); resolved by whether the passage takes a position on allowing AI (neutral if not), keeping permit for duties attached to explicitly permitted use. (2) modality, where 'are expected to' was coded must by one coder; resolved to should, and 'Students should present their work without AI' resolved to should-not. (3) policy_type: P78 vs P05 for the partial-use student duty (P78, the specific duty), P02 vs P56 for the university position (P56), P72 vs UNCOVERED for the OIT consultation line (UNCOVERED), UNCOVERED vs P56 for the advisory-status line (UNCOVERED). (4) phase on data-compliance and tool-enabling lines (general for standing compliance and position statements, before-course for OIT enabling tools). (5) document stance on the Atlas page: encourage vs permit; resolved to encourage because the page urges use. Alignment: the two purpose bullets about UTDSP5017 were coded as different bullets by each coder and kept as separate units. Only-A units kept 9 of 9 (scope, definition, integrity-principles duty, accuracy limit, two benefit lines, ISO guidance purpose, policy purpose bullet, cloud agreements); only-B kept 2 of 3 (policy-alignment bullet, closing aim); dropped B's 'Tailors support to individual needs' pros-table item.
